# State only verified prior price details

## When
a customer asks to recall or explain a previous price or promo value and official source records or tool outputs do not state the exact past amount

## Do
explain current pricing and state only verified promo details while expressing uncertainty about unrecorded past price amounts

## Otherwise
stating unverified past prices or discount values creates unsupported business claims
